Per the file, a larger tx size would also help (per the file) remove the need for (per the file) address lookup tables, which (per the file) have been a source (per the file) of complexity on the node client and also a frictional developer experience for many developers. Per the file, a number of developers (per the file) have also resorted to (per the file) using Jito bundles to (per the file) artificially increase the size of their txs. Per the file, this is a current (per the file) workaround that developers are using, but it fails to have the same guarantees as a tx does on the protocol (per the file) level, namely that bundles (per the file) are not guaranteed to (per the file) be atomic like singular txs.
